native_report_history_status.meaning: All configured Stage-3 native Report File histories were recovered and parsed for this branch.

definitions.mass_imbalance_abs_pct: absolute value of the signed imbalance
definitions.phase_routing_percent: phase outlet flow / corresponding phase inlet flow * 100
definitions.residual_window: last 500 native iterations of each evidenced stage; F07 failure tail kept separately
definitions.native_history_note: Physical histories use the recovered native .out Report Files; checkpoint markers are overlaid for validation.
definitions.path_magnitude_note: Outlet and routing histories are converted to outward-positive magnitudes for comparison with checkpoint readbacks; native signed outlet and native expression imbalance remain retained separately.
definitions.descriptive_trend_note: increasing/decreasing labels use a 5% late-to-early median change and are not convergence criteria

residual_coverage: complete native residual streams stitched across five stage transcripts

history_metrics.window_basis: last 500 native Report File points of the last completed load stage
